_guide.detection: DOM selectors for sidebar chat list detection
_guide.input: DOM selectors for input field location (sidebar feature)
_guide.identity: API endpoint for extracting provider user ID
_guide.pill: Context window widget — DOM selectors + token limit
_guide.pillInterceptor: API patterns for full conversation detail (context pill data)
_guide.chatDetectionPatterns: API patterns for conversation list & delete detection (sidebar data)

_review.purpose: Remote config v7: Made chat detection API patterns remotely patchable. Enables hot-fixes for conversation list/delete endpoints without rebuilds. Backward-compatible: missing patterns fall back to hardcoded defaults.
_review.verifiedOn: 2026-07-14 (added chat detection patterns for all 4 providers)
changes: Added 'chatDetectionPatterns' section with listPatterns + deletePatterns for all 4 providers
ChatGPT, Claude, Grok: list + delete patterns remote. Gemini: batchexecute list pattern only (delete opaque)
Fixed Claude's context pill detailPattern to allow query strings: $ → (?:\?|$)
Bumped version: 6 → 7. Backward-compatible: if chatDetectionPatterns missing, hardcoded defaults used.

codeFiles: src/utils/remoteConfig.ts — Added ProviderPillSelectors + ProviderPillInterceptorConfig interfaces, validation, getters
src/content/contextPill.ts — Loads remote config in init(), uses getPillSelectors(), sends postMessage to interceptor
src/content/contextPillInterceptor.ts — Reads patterns from dataset + window.postMessage, fallback to hardcoded defaults

timing.load: Service worker fetches on startup + 6h timer. Content scripts read cache on init (100ms latency).
timing.update: Content script sends PILL_CONFIG_PUSH postMessage to interceptor after loading. Race: ~500ms before first fetch.
timing.fallback: All remote fields optional. Missing/invalid config → hardcoded DEFAULT_CONFIG used silently.

testing.phase2: Remote config fetches & caches (v6 in chrome.storage.local)
testing.phase3: DOM/interceptor patterns override hardcoded (inject fake config via DevTools)
testing.phase4: Live GitHub deploy test (all 4 providers, each feature: pill, map, bar, export)

status.chatgpt: VERIFIED — context pill shows correct message count, % bar responds to input, chat map works, PDF export button present
status.claude: VERIFIED — same as ChatGPT + PDF export captures full conversation
status.gemini: VERIFIED — context pill works, % bar works, chat map works (no export — batchexecute API is opaque)
status.grok: VERIFIED — context pill works, % bar works, chat map works (no export — separate /response-node endpoint)

postLaunch.monitoring: Watch for selector breakage. Weekly audit recommended (automate with GitHub Actions).
postLaunch.incidents: If provider changes selectors, push v7 config to GitHub within 5 min. Users reload → fixed in 1h (vs 7-day review cycle).
postLaunch.rollback: Push older version to GitHub (version gate prevents downgrade). Users stuck on v6 until they reload.
